headline: Profits accelerate on trading and equity-method gains
summary_short: MUFG reported Q1 FY2027 (three months ended June 30, 2026) ordinary profits of ¥1,117.9 billion, up 57.8% y/y, with net income attributable to owners of parent of ¥809.4 billion (+48.2% y/y) and basic EPS of ¥71.77 (+50.9% y/y).
summary_long: Ordinary income rose 20.1% year-over-year to ¥3,907.5 billion, and ordinary profits jumped 57.8% to ¥1,117.9 billion. Net income attributable to owners of parent grew 48.2% to ¥809.4 billion, with basic EPS of ¥71.77 (+50.9% y/y) and diluted EPS of ¥71.59. Total net assets rose to ¥24.18 trillion from ¥23.74 trillion at fiscal year-end. MUFG reaffirmed its FY2027 (ending March 2027) earnings target of ¥2,700.0 billion in profits attributable to owners of parent, unchanged from the target released May 15, 2026, and its forecast full-year dividend of ¥96.00 per share, also unchanged.
confidence_notes: MUFG's fiscal year runs April-March; the filing labels this period the three months ended June 30, 2026 (MUFG's own fiscal Q1 FY2027), while the platform's period label follows our 'FY2026 Q2' convention -- a labeling-convention difference, not a data mismatch. KPI figures above are read directly from the filed Japanese-GAAP Consolidated Summary Report rather than the resolver's kpis object: the resolver's eps_usd actual (0.45037 USD) and prior_yy (47.55, left in JPY) mix currencies and don't reconcile -- a data-quality issue in the wire feed, not in the filing. All figures here are as-filed, same-currency (million yen); the y/y percentages for ordinary income/profits/net income match the release's own disclosed change percentages exactly.

drivers.explanation: Per the company's own segment reconciliation, growth in ordinary profits was led by net trading profits (+¥89.9bn y/y) and equity in earnings of equity-method investees (+¥103.6bn y/y).
